title: LiteLLM (YC W23) Is Hiring – Rust / Performance Engineers
summary: LiteLLM, a Y Combinator W23-backed company that provides a unified API interface for 100+ LLM providers, is actively hiring Rust and Performance Engineers to optimize their LLM gateway infrastructure. The company offers a proxy solution that standardizes calls across different LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Azure.
problem_solved: Hiring Rust and performance engineers to scale and optimize LiteLLM's unified LLM gateway infrastructure that handles API calls to 100+ different LLM providers.
why_valuable: This role offers the opportunity to work on high-performance systems in the rapidly growing AI infrastructure space, backed by Y Combinator.
